name: Deferred Preview Terminal Cleanup
changes: Tracks deferred thumbnail recovery deadlines by stable article identity rather than a temporary loader element.
Keeps deferred deadlines active during offscreen scrolling, virtualization, and gallery redraws.
Removes unrecoverable image cards after the bounded preview deadline or failed full-image recovery instead of retaining Retry placeholders.
Clears deferred recovery tracking after verified successful preview rendering and preserves Image Sets filtering.
regression_guards: Preserves v3.7.12 gallery stable-identity actions, image watchdogs, and viewer errors.
Preserves v3.7.11 visual image corruption checks and v3.7.9 preview scheduling concurrency.
No NNTP, SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, Automation, download or managed-update changes.
preserved: Image Sets ON/OFF control, gallery virtualization, themes, browser tabs and Newsgroups splitter.
